reviews.x: I've put up with night sweats for many years, toughing it out, tossing off sheets, occasionally running my hands under cold water or using a cold washcloth when it got bad. These pads are a perfect non-medication  -- and dry! -- solution. I bought two. They stay by my bedside and when I get too hot, I place them under my knees or neck, wherever I think they will help. They are thin and comfortable and keep cool for several minutes, enough to cool me down. I've never put them in the fridge. That
Nice pad for a quick cool down.  It gets warm in less than an hour but feels nice for a while. Offers relief from hot flashes

reviews.t: Gel cooling pad is the perfect size
reviews.x: I liked it because after putting it in the refrigerator it kept it's cool for a few hours. When using it with my pillow it didn't make my pillow too hard, which I thought it might. It helped me through my migraines.
I love the way it's cool without refrigeration.  Not icy cold but cold enough to ease hot flashes at night.  It stays cold just long enough before setting aside to regenerate.  Highly recommended.
I love this product it really cools you down even though it is not refrigerated it is nice and cool.

reviews.t: Useless product, cunning way of display (pillow-full)
reviews.x: Certainly this size is smaller than what is on the display (not even half-filling on pillow) - NOT WORTH, buy a better/bigger piece....it doesn't even hold the chillness for over 45-minutes, very disappointed and deceptive marketing by these fellows. Sorry but it is the fact.
It's a nice idea that doesn't work. It stays cool for, if you're lucky 10 minutes. For me it was a waste of money.

This arrived folded in half. I noted the gel is in one half, the other half is flat. I had to gently squish gel to the flat side and now both sides have gel. This pad is smaller than I was hoping it would be based on the picture, but that is my fault.  The second thing I noticed is that is doesn't automatically stay at room temp for long. It quickly heated up. This won't work. The other mats I had stayed cool, this one need to be placed in the fridge to cool enough to last longer than aprox 20 m

reviews.t: Helps to cool down night sweats
reviews.x: I keep this on my nightstand to help me cool off if I get overheated at night. It cools me down in a few minutes and then I put it back on the nightstand so the gel can get cool again. It won't stay cool all night in a pillow case because eventually the gel absorbs the warmth from your body and you have to set it aside to let the gel cool down for about 10-15 minutes depending on how warm it got. The casing is pretty durable and it hasn't burst yet after a month of use. You can push the gel arou

I'm returning this product.  It is flimsy and doesn't really work to cool you.  I have two Chillow Pillows (one large and one travel size).  I'll stick with those for now.  This product is the type of thing that one would see in the Dollar Store for $1.  Don't waste your money.

Just received today and when I first tried it, it was cool. However after just a short time the coolness left and it was actually acting like a heat sink and absorbing my head's heat. It was then warm to the touch and not cool. I did not try it refrigerated yet. My guess is that the coolness will last longer but the same problem will result. Also it is very small. I am also trying a chillow pillow right now and it feels great!! I will order 4 more of these.

reviews.t: North American Healthcare Regular Gell Cooling Pad
reviews.x: [[ASIN:B004PZXJUO North American Healthcare Regular Gel Cooling Pad]]  This thing is very small, considering it is supposed to go inside your pillowcase.  Tried it a few nights & it doesn't stay cool & actually seemed to stay about the temperature of my own body heat.  I put it in the frig thinking that would help but it only stayed cool for about 45 minutes.

This cooling pad is a very thin pad that you insert into your existing pillowcase.  It is a great product and I love it so much that I am going to buy a few more of them and give them as gifts to my friends.

reviews.t: just a few minutes of  cooling
reviews.x: I was looking for longer (some reviewers get 2 hours of cooling).  My single bed pad, which actually works on a queen size,gets me cool for up to 10 minutes max.  It seems too much of a bother to be getting up to put it in the refrigerator and making the bed over and over.

Without refrigeration, it cools you down for about 10 minutes or less.  Then it is warmed by body heat.  I read the dimensions, but did not grasp how small it is.  Not for long term cooling unless you continuously refrigerate.
I still like this product, butnow requires some time in the freezer. Doesn't stay cool anymore by itself. I would still buy this again.
The Regular Gel Cooling Pad warms quickly.  Since that is the opposite of what I expected, I am disappointed in this product.

This pad is very small, but perfect for any spot. I get real hot at night sometimes so I just grab this thing and put it directly behind my neck for 15 minutes and I feel cool again. You can put it in your pillowcase, but it's small so it moves around and it feels less cold. Also works perfectly on your feet or legs! It does not stay cold for hours like it claims. It stays cool for 30 minutes or less. When it warms up toss it on the floor and within a few minutes you're good to go again. For ext

If you noticed, there are mixed reviews on this item.  I can explain why. I purchased one on January 29, 2014 and loved it!  It's nice and thick and squishy soft with gel.  It cools for hours. BUT, I ordered a second one on February 1, 2014 and was very, very disappointed.  It was skinny with very little gel.  As a matter of fact, there was absolutely no gel on one half of it when it arrived.  It hadn't leaked or anything, so it wasn't damaged. The first one came in the box pictured on the produ

My first use of this product occurred after I had put it in the refrigerator for two days to get it cool, even though manufacturer stated this was not necessary. However, once the refrigeration coolness wore off, it was abundantly clear that refrigeration was necessary to get the promised cooling from this pad. Whether refrigerated or not, this pad isn't comfortable to lay one's head on, even under multiple layers of padding over it -- just too hard! I doubt that most people would be comforted w

I suffer from hot flashes any time any place! This is the small cooling pad and I can take it about with me in my purse. It's also great to have sitting by the bed to grab at night. It stays cold for a good 10 mins which is enough time to chill me down a little. I recommend it to anyone who needs to carry one around with them. I plan on getting a bigger one for my bed. I haven't tried refrigerating it, I just let it cool naturally. It may stay cooler for longer if it is refrigerated first.

reviews.t: Gel moves to one side - stays cool for a few hours
reviews.x: It does stay cool for a few hours but if you sleep on it then it actually heats up.  Another thing that is annoying is the gel moves to one side of the pad so you have to smash it out once in a while.  It does this after being either laid upon or if you have it upright against your back. I think it needs individual stitched squared for the gel so it doesn't move around as much.  Works ok for the price but doesn't keep me cool enough at night like I wanted.

reviews.t: Pay attention to the size of the pad.
reviews.x: So much potential - why so small? Cooling area is only about 7 x 11. Draw that out for yourself and see how much space on the pillow is taken up. I underestimated how much coverage that is. Lesson learned. You open it, and it may seem to only have gel on one half of the pad. Work with it to get the gel over to the other side. I like the feel of it and am glad it isn't a wet cooling product.

reviews.t: Way too small, way too little gel
reviews.x: This product is inferior to products I have used in Asia.  I was shocked to find how small it was.  Not only that, as with my review of the cooling gel pad, there is much too little gel inside this product to be effective and it moves around so you do not get an even cool, what short lived cooling you do get.

It doesn't stay cold for very long. I do like that fact that I don't have to use a wet wash cloth on my forehead when I have a headache tho. I can just fold this and lay it on my forehead and it feels good for a little while

claims.text: Many reviewers find the pad provides effective, non-medicated relief for night sweats and hot flashes, especially for short cooling sessions.
A common complaint is that the cooling effect is short-lived, often lasting only minutes to under an hour before warming up.
Several reviewers say the pad is smaller than expected based on the product images.
Some reviewers report the pad works well without refrigeration, staying cool enough to ease hot flashes.
A few reviewers describe the product as flimsy or poor quality and not worth the money.
